Exercise 1.2 · Week 1

Mixed-Up Jump (bug hunt)

Scratch (offline app) Work in pairs

Goal: find and fix a bug where two steps are in the wrong order. Tool: Scratch app (offline). Work in pairs.

The cat should: say "Watch me jump!", jump up, come back down to the ground, and say "Ta-da!". But this script has a bug.

Build steps

  1. Start a new project: File > New.
  2. Build the script below exactly as written, bug and all. change y by is in Motion (y means up and down). wait is in Control.
  3. Click the green flag. Watch carefully. What did the cat do?
  4. Find the two blocks that are in the wrong order. Drag them to fix the order.
  5. Test again. Save as mixed-up-jump.

The script in words (with the bug)

Cat sprite, one script:

  • when green flag clicked
  • go to x: 0 y: -100
  • say "Watch me jump!" for 2 seconds
  • change y by -50
  • wait 0.5 seconds
  • change y by 50
  • say "Ta-da!" for 2 seconds

Debugging steps

  1. What did I expect?
  2. What happened?
  3. Read the blocks one at a time with your finger and act them out.
  4. Change one thing, then test again.

Expected behavior

After your fix: the cat says "Watch me jump!", moves up, waits half a second, comes back down to where it started, then says "Ta-da!".

Checklist

Stuck? Open a hint

Try on your own first. Hints open one at a time, from a small nudge to a bigger one. None of them gives the answer away.

Hint 1: Where to look

Click the green flag and watch the cat closely. Does it jump up first, or go down first? Say out loud what you expected and what really happened.

Hint 2: Try this

Read your blocks one at a time with your finger and act each one out. The change y by blocks in the Motion category move the cat up or down. A positive number means up. A negative number means down.

Hint 3: Almost there

Think about the jump in order: up first, then back down. Look at the numbers in your blocks and ask which way each one moves the cat. Try dragging one block to a different spot, then click the flag. Change only one thing at a time.
